AWC_TO_COMPILER.seam: CompilerWorkflowAdapter (data-only, versioned, not implemented in Phase 0)
AWC_TO_COMPILER.rule: never reclassify an AUTHORITATIVE governance node as agent work; fail closed on unknown version/node

AWC_TO_H16.rule: H16 must not silently reselect an agent in a way that broadens permissions, authority_scope, provider allowance, data residency, tool access, cost ceiling, or quality floor; fallback from AWC-approved set or governed reassessment

AWC_TO_MODEL_SELECTION.awc_selects: functional AI agents for workflow roles
AWC_TO_MODEL_SELECTION.model_selection_selects: models/providers that may power a selected agent invocation
AWC_TO_MODEL_SELECTION.rule: AWC must not rank LLMs, call provider registries, choose endpoints, implement fallback models, or duplicate Model Selection policy

AWC_TO_AGENT_RUNTIME.handoff: AgentTeamPlan -> Agent Runtime adapter -> WorkflowDefinition/TaskDefinition/runtime assignment
AWC_TO_AGENT_RUNTIME.rule: runtime may narrow but never broaden authority/permission bounds; unsupported agent versions fail closed; assignment digests + policy versions preserved; outcomes refer back to plan

AWC_TO_H22.rule: H22 schedules already-staffed workflows; must not select agents, change assignments, broaden authority, invent fallbacks, or override residency/provider constraints; may pause/surface on unavailability, never ungoverned reselection
